messages:
maria_g: Opening RFC/PRD thread for scoped tokens + org/project RBAC. Customer asks have piled up (enterprise SSO customers, SOC2 requests). Proposal: add short-lived scoped tokens for API keys (fine-grained scopes per-project), map org->project->role hierarchy, and provide a migration path for existing API keys. Looking for scope, acceptance criteria, and launch constraints.
kevin_cho: thanks. prioritization note: 2 enterprise deals contingent on scoped tokens + audit trail. PM ask: must have a GA plan and migration docs. Timeline?
ale c: quick notes from infra: we can implement token scopes as JWT claims and validate in our gateway. Need to decide: opaque vs JWT, introspection cost, and rotation UX.
lia_tsai: security standpoint: prefer short TTL + refresh tokens for long-lived service accounts. Also require revocation and immediate deny list. Audit logs must include token id, subject, scopes, and action.
maria_g: rough acceptance criteria draft: 1) API supports creating scoped token with project-level scope and role (read/write/admin). 2) Gateway enforces scope on every request. 3) Admin UI shows live tokens and allows revoke. 4) Audit export for last 90 days. 5) Backwards compatibility: existing keys keep working until revoked/migrated.
kevin_cho: add success metric: reduce enterprise legal stalls by 80% and close 2 deals. Also add migration adoption target: 50% of active keys migrated in first 90 days for new enterprise customers.
ale c: edge cases: cross-project requests (service needs access to multiple projects) -> support multi-scope tokens or service principals bound to multiple projects. Also rate-limit implications when introspecting every request. Suggest gateway cache with TTL matching token TTL.
lia_tsai: threat cases: stolen token with broad scope. Mitigations: scope minimization, default TTL=24h for API keys, optional 7d for service accounts with rotation required. Also IP allowlist and MFA for token creation in UI.
maria_g: draft rollout plan: alpha (internal + SRE) -> beta (opt-in for select customers) -> GA. Feature flags at gateway + Console. CLI: `rw token create --project proj-123 --scopes write,embeddings --ttl 24h` examples in docs.
kevin_cho: launch criteria: (A) Gateway enforcement integrated and canary tested, (B) Console token management UI, (C) Migration CLI + script, (D) Audit exports validated, (E) Docs and customer runbook ready.
lia_tsai: tests: unit + integration + e2e with real request flow, fuzz token parsing, and a simulated replay/abuse test. Also verify revocation propagation within 30s.
devops-bot: checklist created: RFC-1719854321 | owners: maria_g, alec | due: 2024-07-12 | status: triage
maria_g: owner notes: alec will lead gateway changes, lia for security acceptance, i'll own product + migration docs. Kevin will handle customer comms. I'll post a formal PRD next week with acceptance test matrix and sample policies. Please drop comments inline or react with :thumbsup: if ok to proceed.
